name: web-dark-sticker-collage-fintech-hero
title: Dark Fintech Hero with Sticker Collage
whatItIs: A charcoal landing hero with a wide extended-bold white headline 'The Modern Way to Live', a yellow pill CTA, and a tilted translucent dashboard covered in collage elements: a QR sticker, a yellow starburst, round icon chips, photo cutouts and a mauve card.
whatItMeans: The collage and tilt bring rebellious, zine-like energy to a normally sober fintech, while yellow on charcoal keeps it bold and readable.
techniques: Ultra-wide extended sans in caps for the headline
Tilted, plastic-wrapped dashboard mockup for texture
Sticker and cut-out elements layered around the UI
Yellow as the sole accent against charcoal
Grain overlay on elements for a printed feel
bestFor: Brands that want to feel anti-corporate
Hero sections that need a maximal, playful look

vocabulary.definition: Mixing UI, photos and stickers in overlapping stacks.
A screenshot rotated in perspective to add dynamism.
